questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
You must come to a complete stop and yield the right-of-way.
Slow down, be prepared to stop, and, if necessary, yield the right-of-way.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be prepared to stop, and, if necessary, yield the right-of-way.
questions.explanation: A triangular sign means you must yield. Slow down as you approach the intersection and be ready to stop. Let other vehicles, bicyclists, and pedestrians pass before you continue.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the roadway.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road is curving sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is curving sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: Chevron signs show that the road curves sharply in the direction the arrow points. In this case, the road curves to the left. You may see several of these signs throughout the curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Drivers can use hand signals instead of turn signals. When a driver extends their left arm straight out to the side, it means they plan to turn left or change lanes to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign works with a traffic signal to tell drivers that left-turning traffic must wait for oncoming traffic to pass before turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep downhill section is coming ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert drivers to upcoming road hazards. This sign warns of a sharp turn ahead and tells you to reduce your speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This one-way sign tells drivers that traffic can only move in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means a traffic signal is coming. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs control how drivers must drive. This sign shows the direction you must drive on a one-way street.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert drivers to road hazards. This sign warns that an area with low clearance is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive slowly and sound your horn.
You are entering a school's parking lot.

questions.explanation: This is a warning sign. Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that a school zone is ahead. You should slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert you to upcoming hazards. This sign warns you that a traffic signal is ahead. Be ready to stop for a red or yellow light.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals are used instead of mechanical turn signals. When a rider's left arm is bent at the elbow and pointing upward, it means the rider plans to turn right or change lanes to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you that a curve is ahead in the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers on or near the roadway.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert you to upcoming hazards. This sign warns you that pedestrians may be crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left, then right.
The road ahead curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road curves right and then left ahead. Slow down so you can safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the entrance to one-way streets and ramps. It tells you that you cannot continue driving in your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road turns sharply right and then sharply left ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
Specific turning movements are allowed from specific lanes.
Drivers in both lanes are responsible for merging smoothly.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane. These lanes are only for buses and vehicles with the required number of passengers as shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don’t park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle and slash over a symbol means that action is not allowed. In this case, the right turn symbol is crossed out, so right turns are prohibited.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: U-turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This three-sided sign tells you to slow down when approaching an intersection. Be ready to stop and let other drivers or pedestrians go first. You can proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A roundabout is coming up. Enter slowly and let traffic already in the circle go first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black symbols or text. They alert you to hazards or special conditions ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must travel at the speed indicated.
The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
You must travel through the intersection at the posted speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the highest speed allowed on this road. In bad weather or poor conditions, drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill or downgrade is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Traffic lights from bottom to top are green, yellow, then red.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
No trucks are allowed on an upcoming hill.
There are trucks on an upcoming hill.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill or downgrade is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign tells you that an intersection is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Right turns are not allowed at this location.
